cases.narrative_basis: PX4 issue #27013 reports altitude spikes and near-crash behavior during a real fixed-wing autonomous flight.
cases.acceptance_reason: Accepted: real public PX4 Flight Review ULog; original binary retrievable and SHA256 pinned; PX4 documents Flight Review public logs as CC-BY PX4; pinned PAMIR environment parsed sufficient telemetry; narrative classification is independent of PAMIR output; two frozen v0.1 replays produced byte-identical reports.
cases.notes: CI replay passed source resolution, SHA256 verification, two frozen PAMIR v0.1 analyses, and byte-for-byte determinism gate. PAMIR detected first/root deviation at battery_status.voltage_prediction @ 190472820 us. Confidence is the frozen v0.1 uncalibrated anomaly-strength heuristic, not probability of causation. Source/narrative label remains independent of PAMIR output.
cases.license_source: PX4 Guide — Statistical Flight Log Analysis / Flight Review Public Logs

cases.narrative_basis: PX4 issue #9260 reports an F450/Pixhawk 2.1 flight that ended a mission, hovered in position hold, then moved laterally while descending and crashed. PX4 discussion notes the ULog stops before the reported loss event, so evidence sufficiency is limited.
cases.acceptance_reason: Original Flight Review UUID is independently preserved by PX4 issue #9260, but current automated retrieval failed: the UUID is absent from Flight Review dbinfo and canonical CDN fallback returned HTTP 403 in CI run 35594098893. No PAMIR result is recorded.
cases.license_source: PX4 Guide — Statistical Flight Log Analysis / Flight Review Public Logs
cases.notes: Quarantined without scoring. Replay and determinism steps were skipped because original ULog retrieval failed with HTTP 403. This case remains useful for evidence-sufficiency tracking but is excluded from aggregate validation metrics until the original binary is retrievable and SHA256-pinned.
